title: Treat the adapter and runtime as one release contract
description: Select an adapter artifact, deployment mode, and serving target. Compatibility, evaluation, integrity, and rollback gates update independently.
modelNote: These manifests are teaching fixtures. A production gate should verify immutable digests and execute a real load-and-evaluate smoke test.

modes.label: Dynamic adapter
modes.detail: The runtime loads the exact frozen base and activates the adapter separately.

modes.label: Merged checkpoint
modes.detail: A controlled build merges the delta into the exact base and publishes a new full checkpoint.

adapters.label: Support schema adapter v4
adapters.detail: Passed held-out task, rare-slice, and safety gates with a signed manifest.

adapters.label: Experimental rank-64 adapter
adapters.detail: Training completed, but rare-slice evidence, signature, and rollback packaging are incomplete.

adapters.label: Billing adapter v2
adapters.detail: A valid release built for a different base and tokenizer family.

runtimes.label: Shared base runtime v3
runtimes.detail: Loads the pinned 8B base and supports current dynamic and merged artifacts.

runtimes.label: Unreviewed base patch
runtimes.detail: Uses the same architecture but a different base revision than the adapter manifest.

runtimes.label: Template drift runtime
runtimes.detail: Loads the correct base but changed tokenizer and chat-template contracts.

runtimes.label: Merged checkpoint runtime
runtimes.detail: Serves signed full checkpoints but does not load dynamic PEFT adapters.
